## 中文

- [修复] 优化页面 UI、侧边栏与过渡动画，解决上一版本中侧边栏滚动、缩放切换卡顿及画面闪烁的问题。
- [优化] 调整缓存读取与游戏链接预连接流程，缩短游戏启动和资源加载时间。
- [优化] 重构 DMM 与 FANZA 游戏加载流程，新增加载遮罩，仅在可操作的游戏画面准备完成后显示，避免包装页、广告和活动横幅闪现。
- [优化] 游戏画面、侧边栏与窗口尺寸现在会实时联动，并适配双击标题栏放大或还原窗口。
- [功能] 新增窗口置顶功能，可从标题栏快速切换并自动记住设置。
- [功能] 新增可选的匿名使用人数统计，显示同时在线、今日活跃和累计安装人数；首次启动会明确征求同意，也可以拒绝参与。
- [优化] 公告与更新提示改为独立浮层，显示期间不会停止游戏加载；公告支持点击外部区域关闭。
- [外观] 统一深色模式下顶栏、底栏、侧边栏和加载区域的视觉效果。
- [修复] 完善更新版本、安装包和文件完整性校验，提高后续自动更新的可靠性。

## English

- [Fix] Refined the page UI, sidebar, and transition animations, resolving sidebar scrolling stalls, zoom-transition stutter, and visual flashes from the previous release.
- [Improvement] Optimized cache reads and game-origin preconnection to reduce startup and resource-loading time.
- [Improvement] Reworked the DMM and FANZA loading flow with a loading mask that reveals the page only when the playable game view is ready, preventing wrapper pages, advertisements, and campaign banners from flashing on screen.
- [Improvement] Synchronized the game view, sidebar, and window dimensions in real time, including maximize and restore behavior when double-clicking the title bar.
- [Feature] Added a persistent always-on-top control in the title bar.
- [Feature] Added optional anonymous counts for concurrent users, daily active installations, and total installations; first launch asks for explicit consent and users may decline participation.
- [Improvement] Moved notices and update prompts into a separate overlay so game loading continues underneath; notices can also be dismissed by clicking outside them.
- [Appearance] Unified the title bar, bottom bar, sidebar, and loading surfaces in dark mode.
- [Fix] Strengthened release-version, installer, and file-integrity validation to make future automatic updates more reliable.
